result.title: CPVB-RG: Cross-Prior Visual Bridging for Prior-Aware Chest X-Ray Report Generation
result.summary: Radiologists interpret follow-up chest X-rays by comparing current and prior examinations to identify new, resolved or progressing findings. Most report generation systems either omit this longitudinal context or fuse prior features without distinguishing interval changes from anatomy that remains stable over time. We propose CPVB-RG, a prior-aware framework that combines current and prior radiographs with available clinical text. Its Cross-Prior Visual Bridge (CPVB) contains Progression-Guided Focus Attention (PGFA) and two Cross-Attention units. PGFA is designed to contrast progression-difference attention with shared-spatial attention, aiming to reduce invariant responses whilst retaining coarse spatial correspondence between examinations. The Cross-Attention units then connect the resulting longitudinal visual evidence with clinical semantics. CPVB-RG is trained in two stages, using prior-guided image-text alignment followed by autoregressive report generation with a lightweight language decoder. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR and IU X-Ray show consistent improvements across language and clinical metrics. On MIMIC-CXR, CPVB-RG achieves 0.2847 F1RadGraph and 0.6692 VLScore, with statistically significant gains over the closest decoder-matched prior-aware baseline. These results support the effectiveness of the proposed difference-aware and spatially guided fusion design for prior-aware chest X-ray report generation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CPVB-RG 先验感知胸片报告生成框架：用 Progression-Guided Focus Attention 对比间隔变化注意力与共享空间注意力，再以两个交叉注意力单元把纵向视觉证据与临床文本语义结合，两阶段训练后在 MIMIC-CXR 与 IU X-Ray 上报告指标提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其差分注意力显式抑制跨检查不变响应、保留变化区域，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与冗余视觉信息抑制提供可核查线索，但论文本身不研究 latent 推理状态的生成与使用。
